title: UX-01 task 9: validation, visual review fixes and documents
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 9: all 63 reference stories captured at 1440 x 900, 1180 x 820 and 820 x 1180 in Paper and Ink (378 captures and contact sheets in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/final/, no page errors) and reviewed against the section 33 rejection criteria; the findings are recorded in docs/validation/ux-design-system.md.

Takedown fallback on the match: board and hand placeholders grew past the card's size and covered neighbours, and decorative symbol placeholders repeated the adjacent word. CardImage gains placeholder="name" for small renditions (name only, from the top edge, within the card's proportion; every placeholder now keeps the proportion); BoardCard and Counter leave decorative symbols out when Lorcana assets are switched off. HandFan and BoardCard pass the name-only placeholder.

Deck validation: an incomplete deck showed Rules with the success mark and 'Nothing to resolve' beside '60 more cards needed'. The demonstration validator now makes the missing cards a rule to resolve (warning), the deckbuilder summary bar counts every non-information rule, and ValidationSummary shows the success mark only on a section without messages, the information mark for information alone.

Stories: EmptyDeck is now the full deckbuilder with a new, never-saved deck (it showed a lone deck panel pointing to a catalog that was not on screen); the none-held product shares the quiet product slot that names the set instead of an empty slot.

Match bottom row: at 1180 px a 12-card hand's intrinsic width squeezed the player summary until the name and turn marker broke. From 64 rem the outer columns match the decision column's content width; HandFan slices narrow to fit the region (container query) but never below the 44 px control minimum, scrolling only beyond that, with room for the outer cards' drop; the view switch sits under the summary; the turn marker never wraps. check-styles.mjs allows the runtime variable --hand-count, which HandFan already set inline.

ADR 0017 amendment (UX-01 reference screens, D27 and D28: reference stories, new and changed components, card back, tokens and icons, runtime variables, the development-only presentation dependency, the table scene and the interpretations made); design-system README; runbook (takedown placeholders, hand slices, bottom row); validation (task 9 review and receipts); F-DESIGN-SYSTEM and F-RENDERER; documentation-map edges from packages/presentation/** to the design-system runbook, validation and ADR 0017; UX-01 backlog row; plan and design status lines; status lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md; handoff.

The validation browser test also checks the empty deck's Rules section ('1 to resolve', '60 more cards needed'). Receipts: isolated design-system (RUN-20261022-042) and foundation (RUN-20261022-043) pipelines passed on the source before the review fixes; after the fixes the full design-system Chromium suite passed 409/409 (RUN-20261022-044). On the final source the isolated design-system (RUN-20261022-046) and foundation (RUN-20261022-047) pipelines passed.
